chunks: O believers, fear God as He should be feared, and do not die but submitting (to Him).

key_terms.حَقَ تُقَاتِهِ: as He should be feared / true piety

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to fear God as He should be feared?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Haqq Taqatihi' (true piety), emphasizing that believers must maintain their faith with the same intensity as the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) did, particularly through adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt. It underscores the necessity of dying in a state of complete submission to God's will, which in Shia tradition is intrinsically tied to recognizing and following the Imams as the true guides of the Ummah.
